verdict.rationale: Warp's docs describe an API definition that can be used to generate clients, configure API tools, and give documentation-aware AI tools access, which implies a machine-readable spec. An llms.txt is also live. However, the snippet doesn't name the format or a download URL. The probe of standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, though guessed paths alone don't contradict the claim. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of the spec format (OpenAPI or equivalent), a documented download location, hands-on verification that the spec is retrievable.
